# 08-analyses

ASIL decomposition, coexistence, DFA, system FTA/FMEA, STPA; [`fmea/`](fmea/fmea-plan.md) holds the AIAG-VDA FMEA data (YAML, checked by `tools/safety/fmea_lint.py`) that supports them.

Standard clauses: 26262-9, AIAG-VDA FMEA 2019.
